sql:
SELECT winner AS competitor,
       COUNT(*) AS frequency,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM answers WHERE engine = 'chatgpt'), 1) AS share_pct
FROM answers
WHERE engine = 'chatgpt'
  AND winner <> 'Kurta Co'
GROUP BY winner
ORDER BY frequency DESC;

SELECT winner AS competitor,
       COUNT(*) AS frequency,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GLISPER_DEMO.answers WHERE engine = 'chatgpt'), 1) AS share_pct
FROM GLISPER_DEMO.answers
WHERE engine = 'chatgpt'
  AND winner <> 'Kurta Co'
GROUP BY winner
ORDER BY frequency DESC LIMIT 200

WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT a.result_id, a.run_date, a.engine, a.status
  FROM answers a
  WHERE a.engine = 'chatgpt'
    AND a.winner <> 'Kurta Co'
),
answer_domains AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.result_id, f.run_date, f.status, s.domain
  FROM filtered f
  JOIN answer_sources s
    ON f.result_id = s.result_id
   AND f.run_date = s.run_date
   AND f.engine = s.engine
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'won' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_won,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'won' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_not_won
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT result_id, run_date, status FROM filtered) t
),
domain_stats AS (
  SELECT
    domain,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'won' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS won_citations,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'won' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS not_won_citations
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT result_id, run_date, status, domain FROM answer_domains) d
  GROUP BY domain
)
SELECT
  ds.domain,
  ROUND(100.0 * ds.not_won_citations / t.total_not_won, 1) AS not_won_pct,
  ROUND(100.0 * ds.won_citations / t.total_won, 1) AS won_pct
FROM domain_stats ds
CROSS JOIN totals t
WHERE t.total_not_won > 0 AND t.total_won > 0
ORDER BY not_won_pct DESC, won_pct ASC;
